newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DOLLAR HELPS BOOST HUNTER DOUGLAS H1.
newsitem.headline: DOLLAR HELPS BOOST HUNTER DOUGLAS H1.

text.p: Window blinds and building products maker Hunter Douglas said on Wednesday its first-half net profit rose 21.3 percent to 76.3 million guilders.
The company said the profit rise, which was in line with market expectations, reflected improved results in the Americas and Asia, lower interest costs and the stronger dollar.
Separate dollar accounts which it published showed a rise in first-half profit of 7.7 percent to $40.5 million.
First-half sales rose 14.8 percent to 1.28 billion guilders. Volumes rose 4.6 percent, acquisitions lifted sales by 2.4 percent while positive currency movements added 7.8 percent.
Sales in North and South America showed strong growth, while sales in Europe and Australia were lower.
Hunter Douglas said profits in Europe and Australia showed "some improvement", partly due to cost reductions.
The company said it was optimistic about the outlook for the rest of the year.
